## Personality

Susan Baker is a grim-faced yet kind-hearted elderly spinster from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) who disdains cats. She possesses notable skill in baking, including making strawberry shortcake.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)_

## History

Susan Baker, who never had suitors when she was young, served as the housekeeper for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She handled the household duties during Anne's recoveries, including the period following the death of Anne's firstborn and after the birth of Anne's healthy son, [James Matthew](../character/james-matthew.md). Susan temporarily left the household to care for her sister after an accident, returning with local gossip after her sister recovered. When [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed moving the family to a larger home, Susan welcomed the move for its practical benefits.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P3](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P11](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P2](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0002), +32 more_

## Quotes

> "I am of the opinion that we will all be glad of a bite and sup. You tell young Mrs. Doctor not to worry about a single thing—Susan is at the helm. You tell her just to think of her baby."
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010)

> "Oh, the poor lamb—the poor lamb! How can she bear it, Miss Cuthbert? I am afraid it will kill her. She has been that built up and happy, longing for that baby, and planning for it. Cannot anything be done nohow, Miss Cuthbert?"
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P18](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0018)

> "I never saw one so white—they are mostly red or yallow. And it opened its big eyes as if it was months old. The little, little thing! Oh, the poor, young Mrs. Doctor!"
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P20](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0020)

> "Have a good time and do not worry about the pantry. Susan is at the helm. There is no use in keeping a dog and doing your own barking. I am going to take your breakfast up to you every morning."
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P3](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0003)

> "If you cannot I will not go, Mrs. Doctor, dear, Matilda’s leg to the contrary notwithstanding. I will not have you worried, and that blessed child upset in consequence, for any number of legs."
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P23](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--susan.md)

Susan serves as an affectionate household helper to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), whom she respectfully addresses as "Mrs. Doctor" and "dear." She assists with domestic responsibilities, and alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she insists that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rest and delegate household duties to her following the tragic loss of Anne's newborn daughter. She also shares news from the community with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her household.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), +10 more_
